name: MinecraftDarkSouls
description: Hardcore Dark Souls & Elden Ring combat experience in Minecraft: Legendary bosses (Knight Artorias, Margit the Fell Omen), sewer omens, wargs, goblins, and authentic Souls mechanics with Dodge Rolls (i-frames), Ground Slam, Stance Breaks & Critical Riposte for solo & LAN co-op.
